startupPolicy.progress: Fresh visitor-local state only. No personal records, review history, schedules, notes, ratings, or playlists are imported.
startupPolicy.membership: No seeded Memory or Story collections for a fresh visitor. Explicit visitor-selected BSB items only; touched former public story IDs retained by bounded migration.
startupPolicy.scripture: Allow explicit visitor selection of exact BSB verse, passage, or whole chapter; do not prepopulate a private collection.
startupPolicy.summaries: No summary collection is supplied. A future summary needs an explicitly approved redistributable source or visitor-created content, kept distinct from Scripture.
startupPolicy.images: No mnemonic or story images are supplied. Do not reuse private photographs, slide pictures, or private cue imagery.
startupPolicy.audio: Preserve only the five existing standard public featured collections. Do not create public playlists or import private presets.

missingContentIsIntentional: Private mnemonic book pictures and summary cards are not approved public content.
There is no approved complete public book-summary catalog in this package.
The complete BSB is not vendored; chapter reading currently requires the existing online source.

compatibilityOnly.policy: Restore or retain only durably referenced former public definitions; catalogVersions alone never seeds visitor content.
